dashboard.label: Coverage
dashboard.description: What the feed can and cannot say anything about. Read this before trusting a low finding count.

div.b: A low finding count is not the same as a secure fleet.

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | stats dc(name) AS components BY type | sort - components | head 40

viz.option: No inventory has been received. Nothing can be assessed until swinv data reaches the index.

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | eval has_identifier = if(isnotnull(purl) OR isnotnull(cpes), 1, 0) | stats count AS components, sum(has_identifier) AS with_identifier BY type | eval without_identifier = components - with_identifier | eval identifier_pct = round(with_identifier * 100 / components, 1) | sort - components | rename type AS "Ecosystem", components AS "Components", with_identifier AS "With purl/cpe", without_identifier AS "No identifier", identifier_pct AS "Identifiable %"

`riskability_latest_inventory` | riskabilitymatch include_informational=true | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | stats dc(package) AS packages, dc(cve_id) AS cves BY root, hostname | sort - packages | rename root AS "Root", hostname AS "Host", packages AS "Packages", cves AS "CVEs"

panel.title: Ecosystems present in the fleet but absent from the feed

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | stats count AS components BY type | join type=left type [| inputlookup riskability_ranges_lookup | stats dc(package) AS feed_packages BY ecosystem | rename ecosystem AS type] | eval feed_packages = coalesce(feed_packages, 0) | eval status = case(feed_packages > 0, "covered", type IN ("linux-kernel-module","linux-kernel","github-action","github-action-workflow","binary"), "no feed exists for this type", 1=1, "add this ecosystem to the bundle") | sort - components | rename type AS "Ecosystem", components AS "Components in fleet", feed_packages AS "Packages in feed", status AS "Status"

format.colorPalette: {"covered":#53a051,"add this ecosystem to the bundle":#F8BE34,"no feed exists for this type":#708794}
